method: Items are published only when an official primary source or at least two independent publishers support them.

items.headline: Mongolia reports export revenue of 16.6 billion US dollars in nine months and record reserves
items.summary: Economy Minister Enkhbayar Jadamba said export revenue reached 16.6 billion US dollars in the first nine months of 2026, up 54 percent on a year earlier. Xinhua, citing the government press office, reported that foreign currency reserves rose to a record of about 8.9 billion US dollars at the end of September, driven mainly by export earnings.
items.note: Both figures originate from Mongolian government statements. One open.kg lead paragraph mixes up the two figures; the body text was used.
